CustomField.description: For Reporting, Strategic Importance = Focus, Last Activitiy Created Date >= 30 Strategic Importance = High, Last Activitiy Created Date >= 60 Strategic Importance = Medium, Last Activitiy Created Date >= 90
CustomField.formula: IF ( AND ( ISPICKVAL ( Strategic_Importance__c , "Focus") , No_of_Days_Since_Last_Created_Activity__c >= 30), TRUE, IF ( AND ( ISPICKVAL ( Strategic_Importance__c , "High") , No_of_Days_Since_Last_Created_Activity__c >= 60), TRUE, IF ( AND ( ISPICKVAL ( Strategic_Importance__c , "Medium") , No_of_Days_Since_Last_Created_Activity__c >= 90), TRUE, FALSE ) ) )
CustomField.label: Strategic Importance with no Activity
